name: Crying Heart Patchwork Coat
note: Hearts are one printed layer with a little relief, not hundreds of separate sewn patches; shoulder epaulets left out.

name: Give Peace a Chance Tribal Heart Camo Shirt
note: The family's best-known design, the tribal heart camo, made as the long button-down shirt in the navy and grey colourway photographed; the print is redrawn, not traced.

name: Touch Me I'm Sick Mohair Cardigan
note: No photograph loaded (dealer pages refused): made from the research description. The mohair halo is painted speckle and pilling, not standing fibre.

name: School of Visual Comedy Skull Tee
note: No photograph of the tee loaded: the seal is drawn from the research description (skull, ring of lettering, SINCE 1997), so its lettering layout is approximate.

name: The High Streets Distressed Denim
note: No photograph loaded: the layout of blowouts and repairs is representative, from the research description. Price is a judgement from a thin sales record (150 to 600).

name: But Beautiful "68" Yarn Denim
note: Darning, shredded thigh and red yarn are flat artwork, not loose threads; the jean's displaced pockets are drawn in the usual places.

name: Klaus Patchwork Denim
note: No photograph loaded: the patch layout is representative. The Klaus head is an anonymous figure drawn fresh, the collage and CHUUUT! logo follow the research description, not the original artwork.

name: Arts & Crafts Scab Patch Jacket
note: No photograph loaded and the entry is a family: made as a hip-length over-dyed jacket of mismatched panels with frayed military patches, a fur collar and a gathered placket, from the research description.

name: Scab Patchwork Crust Pants
note: No photograph of the pants loaded: the patched leg is a drawn collage of striped and woven scraps, each pair being different anyway; the wording of the printed leg is not verified and is a stand-in.

name: GURUGURU Hybrid Bomber
note: No photograph loaded and the entry is a family: made as the hybrid bomber (leather body, nylon bomber sleeves, wool back yoke, fur funnel neck ringed with oversized belt loops). Price is a judgement from older sales (280 to 1200).

name: Painted Leather Aviator Jacket
note: Made in the red-orange leather with the '22nd Century Sweetheart' mermaid, the back that was photographed; the pin-up is redrawn as a simplified, covered, anonymous figure rather than the airbrushed original.

name: Pour Homme Button-Lapel Gabardine Blazer
note: A recurring family with no single season: made as the black gabardine blazer whose buttons carry on up the lapel. Lapels are drawn on the cloth, not cut and turned.

name: Pour Homme Floral Rayon Shirt
note: Made from the SS2001 shirt that was photographed (white rayon, red scrolling flowers, open collar, short sleeve) rather than the navy SS2002 long-sleeve version; the flowers are redrawn.

name: Oversized Hakama Trousers
note: No photograph loaded: made from the research description of the wrap-front wool gabardine hakama. The pleats are painted relief on a wide leg, not folded cloth, and the price is for a typical resale pair.

name: Body Meets Dress, Dress Meets Body Dress
note: The pale blue gingham in the Kyoto Costume Institute's photograph; the pads are swellings in the cut.

name: Broken Bride Jacket
note: No Homme Plus collection called Broken Bridegroom could be found. This is the cropped ivory jacket with a round collar from the Comme des Garçons 'Broken Bride' collection of autumn 2005, which the name on the list most likely means.

name: Comme des Garçons Patchwork Denim
note: No photograph could be loaded; drawn from the description of the SS2002 jeans: rectangles of denim washes, tweed and check, a cowhide back pocket, worn cuffed.

name: Parachute Cargo Bomber
note: The black version in the dealer photograph; the sage green is as well known.

name: Pleats Please Pleated Top
note: A sleeveless top in the printed red and green of the photographed example; most Pleats Please is a plain bright colour.
